translations.idiomatic: His senior commander Fan Xichao was a capable soldier. Yougui feared him and plotted his death; Xichao fled to Fengxiang and was summoned to the capital guard.

sentences.zh: 遊瑰遣兵築豐義，才二板而潰，寧卒數百大掠，遊瑰不能禁。

translations.literal: Yougui sent troops to build Fengyi; after only two courses of wall it collapsed; several hundred Ning troops plundered on a great scale, and Yougui could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Yougui sent men to build Fengyi, but the wall collapsed after only two courses. Hundreds of Ning troops looted wildly, and he could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 詔用張獻甫代之。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Zhang Xianfu to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict replaced him with Zhang Xianfu.

sentences.zh: 遊瑰畏亂，委軍輕出，還京師，拜右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: Yougui, fearing disorder, entrusted the army and left lightly, returned to the capital, and was appointed Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing mutiny, Yougui left his army in haste, returned to the capital, and was named commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 卒，謚曰襄。

translations.literal: He died; his posthumous title was Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous title Xiang.

sentences.zh: 廣弘者，自言宗室子。

translations.literal: Guanghong claimed to be a son of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghong claimed to be a member of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 始為浮屠，妄曰：「我嘗見嶽、瀆神，當作天子，可復冠。

translations.literal: He began as a Buddhist monk and falsely said: "I once saw the gods of Mount Heng and the sacred rivers; I am to become Son of Heaven; I can again wear the cap."
translations.idiomatic: He had been a Buddhist monk and declared, "I have seen the gods of Mount Heng and the sacred rivers. I am destined to be emperor and may wear the cap of office again."

sentences.zh: 」男子董昌舍廣弘於資敬寺，召相工唐郛視之，教郛告人曰：「廣弘且大貴。

translations.literal: A man Dong Chang lodged Guanghong at Zijing Temple, summoned physiognomist Tang Fu to examine him, and taught Fu to tell people: "Guanghong is about to attain great nobility."
translations.idiomatic: A man named Dong Chang housed Guanghong at Zijing Temple and brought in the physiognomist Tang Fu, whom he instructed to proclaim that Guanghong was destined for greatness.

sentences.zh: 」乃誘欽緒、神策將魏循、李傪、越州參軍事劉昉等作亂。

translations.literal: He thereupon enticed Qinxu, Shence generals Wei Xun and Li Song, and Yue Prefecture staff member Liu Fang and others to make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He then recruited Qinxu, the Shence generals Wei Xun and Li Song, and the Yue Prefecture staff member Liu Fang and others to rebel.

sentences.zh: 昉家數具酒大會廣弘所，陰相署置。

translations.literal: Fang's household repeatedly set out wine and held great gatherings at Guanghong's place, secretly assigning offices among themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fang's household held repeated banquets at Guanghong's lodging, secretly assigning ranks among the conspirators.

sentences.zh: 又妄曰：「神戒我十月十日趣舉。

translations.literal: He again falsely said: "The gods warned me to rise on the tenth day of the tenth month."
translations.idiomatic: He also declared, "The gods have told me to act on the tenth day of the tenth month."

sentences.zh: 」約欽緒夜擊鼓，噪淩霄門，焚飛龍廄，循等以神策兵迎廣弘，事捷，大剽三日。

translations.literal: They agreed that Qinxu would beat drums by night, clamor at Lingxiao Gate, burn the Flying Dragon stables; Xun and others would welcome Guanghong with Shence troops; if the affair succeeded, there would be great plunder for three days.
translations.idiomatic: They agreed that Qinxu would beat drums at night, storm Lingxiao Gate, and burn the Flying Dragon stables while Xun and the others brought Shence troops to install Guanghong. If they succeeded, they would loot for three days.

sentences.zh: 循、傪上變，乃禽廣弘及支黨鞫仗內，付三司訊實，皆殊死。

translations.literal: Xun and Song reported the plot; thereupon Guanghong and his branch adherents were seized, interrogated within the palace, handed to the Three Offices for verification, and all sentenced to special death.
translations.idiomatic: Xun and Song reported the plot. Guanghong and his followers were seized, interrogated in the palace, handed to the Three Offices, and all sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 廣弘臨刑，色自如。

translations.literal: Facing execution, Guanghong's countenance was as usual.
translations.idiomatic: At execution Guanghong's face showed no change.

sentences.zh: 由是禁人不得入觀、祠。

translations.literal: Thereupon people were forbidden to enter temples and shrines.
translations.idiomatic: After this the public was forbidden to enter temples and shrines freely.

sentences.zh: 杜希全

translations.literal: Du Xiquan.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan

sentences.zh: 杜希全，京兆醴泉人。

translations.literal: Du Xiquan was a man of Liquan in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan came from Liquan in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 以裨將隸郭子儀，積功勞至朔方節度使。

translations.literal: As a subordinate general he served under Guo Ziyi and through accumulated merit reached military commissioner of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: He served Guo Ziyi as a subordinate general and rose through merit to military commissioner of Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 軍令整嚴，士畏其威。

translations.literal: His military orders were strict and severe; soldiers feared his authority.
translations.idiomatic: His discipline was severe and his troops feared him.

sentences.zh: 奉天之狩，希全與鄜坊節度使李建徽、鹽州刺史戴休顏、夏州刺史時常春引兵赴難。

translations.literal: At the imperial hunt at Fengtian, Xiquan with Zheng-Fang military commissioner Li Jianhui, Salt Prefecture Regional Inspector Dai Xiuyan, and Xia Prefecture Regional Inspector Shi Changchun led troops to the crisis.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor withdrew to Fengtian, Xiquan marched with Li Jianhui, military commissioner of Zheng and Fang, Dai Xiuyan, regional inspector of Salt Prefecture, and Shi Changchun, regional inspector of Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 次漠谷，為賊邀擊，乘高縱石下之，強弩雜發。

translations.literal: Halting at Mogu Valley, they were ambushed by rebels who from the heights rolled stones down on them and mixed strong crossbows in firing.
translations.idiomatic: At Mogu Valley they were ambushed; the enemy rolled stones down from the heights and poured crossbow fire into them.

sentences.zh: 德宗使援之，不克，還保邠州。

translations.literal: Dezong sent to relieve them but could not succeed; they returned to hold Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong sent reinforcements but they could not break through; the column fell back to Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊平，遷檢校尚書左僕射、靈鹽豐夏節度使，封餘姚郡王。

translations.literal: When rebels were pacified, he was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and military commissioner of Ling, Yan, Feng, and Xia, enfeoffed as Prince of Yuyao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was crushed he was made acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and military commissioner of Ling, Yan, Feng, and Xia, and created Prince of Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 將即屯，獻《體要》八章，砭切政病。

translations.literal: About to go to his encampment, he presented "Essentials" in eight chapters, piercingly criticizing governmental ills.
translations.idiomatic: Before leaving for his post he submitted "Essentials" in eight chapters, sharply criticizing flaws in government.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納，賜《君臣箴》一篇。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and adopted it, granting one chapter of "Admonitions for Ruler and Minister."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted it and granted him a copy of "Admonitions for Ruler and Minister."

sentences.zh: 尋兼夏綏銀節度都統，建言：「鹽州據要會，為塞保鄣。

translations.literal: Shortly he also held the post of overall commander of Xia, Sui, and Yin circuits and submitted a memorial: "Salt Prefecture occupies a strategic junction and serves as a frontier barrier and protection."
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was also made overall commander of the Xia, Sui, and Yin circuits and memorialized, "Salt Prefecture occupies a strategic junction and is the frontier's chief bulwark."

sentences.zh: 自平涼背盟，城陷於虜，於是靈武勢縣，鄜坊單逼，為邊深患，請復城鹽州。

translations.literal: Since Pingliang broke the alliance, the city fell to the barbarians; thereupon Lingwu's position hung exposed, Zheng-Fang stood alone and pressed — a deep frontier calamity; he requested to restore and fortify Salt Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Pingliang betrayal the city had fallen to the enemy, leaving Lingwu exposed and Zheng-Fang isolated — a grave frontier crisis. He asked to rebuild Salt Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔希全及朔方、邠寧、銀夏、鄜坊、振武及神策行營諸節度合選士三萬五千屯鹽州，又敕涇原、劍南、山南軍深入吐蕃，牽撓其力，使不得犯塞。

translations.literal: An edict thereupon ordered Xiquan and the military commissioners of Shuofang, Binning, Yin-Xia, Zheng-Fang, Zhenwu, and the Shence field army jointly to select thirty-five thousand troops to encamp at Salt Prefecture; it also ordered Jingyuan, Jiannan, and Shannan armies to penetrate deep into Tibet and harass their strength so they could not invade the passes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiquan and the commissioners of Shuofang, Binning, Yin-Xia, Zheng-Fang, Zhenwu, and the Shence field army to assemble thirty-five thousand men at Salt Prefecture, and ordered Jingyuan, Jiannan, and Shannan troops to raid deep into Tibet to pin down enemy forces.

sentences.zh: 執築凡六千人，閱二旬畢。

translations.literal: Those engaged in construction totaled six thousand men; in twenty days it was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand laborers finished the work in twenty days.

sentences.zh: 由是虜憚，不輕入。

translations.literal: Thereby the barbarians feared and did not enter lightly.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy thereafter feared to raid lightly.

sentences.zh: 希全居河西久，頗越法橫肆，帝數容掩其短。

translations.literal: Xiquan dwelt long in Hexi and often exceeded the law in arrogant license; the Emperor several times covered and concealed his faults.
translations.idiomatic: Xiquan had long governed Hexi and often acted above the law; the emperor repeatedly overlooked his excesses.

sentences.zh: 豐州刺史李景略名出希全上，疑逼己，遂排劾之。

translations.literal: Feng Prefecture Regional Inspector Li Jinglue's reputation stood above Xiquan's; suspecting pressure on himself, he thereupon impeached and drove him out.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jinglue, regional inspector of Feng Prefecture, outshone him in reputation. Xiquan, fearing a rival, impeached and drove him out.

sentences.zh: 帝為斥以答其意。

translations.literal: The Emperor dismissed Jinglue to answer his intent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed Jinglue to satisfy him.

sentences.zh: 素苦風眩，稍劇，益忌忍，遂誣殺判官李起，吏下累息。

translations.literal: He had long suffered from dizzy spells; as they grew worse he became more jealous and cruel, and thereupon falsely accused and killed administrative aide Li Qi; officials below held their breath in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He had long suffered dizzy spells; as they worsened he grew more suspicious and cruel, falsely executed his aide Li Qi, and reduced his staff to terrified silence.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously he was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 邢君牙

translations.literal: Xing Junya.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Junya

sentences.zh: 邢君牙，瀛州樂壽人。

translations.literal: Xing Junya was a man of Leshou in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Junya came from Leshou in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少從幽薊、平盧軍，以戰功歷果毅、折沖郎將。

translations.literal: In youth he followed the Youji and Pinglu armies; through battle achievements he rose through defender and assault-resistance commandant.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he served in the Youji and Pinglu armies and rose through battle merit to defender and assault-resistance commandant.

sentences.zh: 安祿山反，從侯希逸涉海入青州。

translations.literal: When An Lushan rebelled, he followed Hou Xiyi across the sea into Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan rebelled, he followed Hou Xiyi by sea into Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 田神功為兗鄆節度使，使君牙將兵屯好畤防盛秋。

translations.literal: When Tian Shenggong was military commissioner of Yan and Yun, he had Junya lead troops to encamp at Haozhi to guard against the autumn raids.
translations.idiomatic: When Tian Shenggong was military commissioner of Yan and Yun, he stationed Junya at Haozhi to guard against autumn raids.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃犯京師，代宗出陜，以扈從功，累封河間郡公。

translations.literal: When Tibetans raided the capital, Emperor Daizong went out to Shan; for escort merit he was repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Hejian Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Tibet raided the capital, Emperor Daizong withdrew to Shan. For his escort service Junya was repeatedly enfeoffed as Duke of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 建中初，李晟從馬燧討田悅，以君牙為都將，在武安、襄國間凡五戰，斬馘功最。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong, Li Sheng followed Ma Sui to attack Tian Yue; he made Junya chief commander; between Wu'an and Xiangguo in all five battles he took the most heads and trophies.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jianzhong era Li Sheng campaigned with Ma Sui against Tian Yue and made Junya his chief commander. In five battles between Wu'an and Xiangguo he won the greatest share of kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 德宗出奉天，晟率君牙倍道赴難，徙屯渭橋，軍中便宜，惟君牙得豫。

translations.literal: When Dezong went out to Fengtian, Sheng led Junya by double marches to the crisis, moved encampment to Wei Bridge; within the army discretionary authority — only Junya was allowed to participate.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong withdrew to Fengtian, Sheng raced Junya to the rescue and shifted camp to Wei Bridge. Of Sheng's staff only Junya was consulted on urgent military decisions.

sentences.zh: 晟在鳳翔，數行邊，常以君牙守。

translations.literal: When Sheng was at Fengxiang, he often went on frontier tours and regularly had Junya hold the post.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng was at Fengxiang he often toured the frontier and regularly left Junya in command.

sentences.zh: 晟入朝，代為鳳翔觀察使。

translations.literal: When Sheng entered court, Junya replaced him as observation commissioner of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng went to court, Junya succeeded him as observation commissioner of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 俄領節度，檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Shortly he took command of the circuit and was made Acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he took the military commission and was named acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃歲犯邊，君牙劭耕講戰以為備，戎不能侵。

translations.literal: Tibetans yearly raided the frontier; Junya urged farming and lectured on warfare as preparation, and the Rong could not invade.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided the border every year; Junya urged farming and drilled his troops for war, and the enemy could not break through.

sentences.zh: 又城隴州平戎川，號永信城。

translations.literal: He also fortified Pingrongchuan in Long Prefecture and named it Yongxin Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He also fortified Pingrongchuan in Long Prefecture and named the stronghold Yongxin Fort.

sentences.zh: 卒官，贈司空。

translations.literal: He died in office; posthumously he was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office and was posthumously made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 初，布衣張汾者，無紹而干君牙，軒然坐客上。

translations.literal: Initially a commoner named Zhang Fen, without connection he approached Junya and sat prominently above the guests.
translations.idiomatic: Early on a commoner named Zhang Fen sought out Junya without any introduction and took a seat above the other guests as if he belonged there.

sentences.zh: 會吏擿簿書，以盜沒宴錢五萬，君牙怒其欺，汾不謝去，曰：「吾在京師，聞邢君牙一時豪俊，今乃與設吏論錢，云何？

translations.literal: When a clerk discovered in the account books that fifty thousand of banquet funds had been embezzled, Junya was angry at the deception; Fen did not apologize but left, saying: "I am in the capital; I heard that Xing Junya was a hero of the age — now you argue over money with a petty clerk — how is this?"
translations.idiomatic: When a clerk found in the accounts that fifty thousand strings of banquet funds had been stolen, Junya was furious at the fraud. Fen offered no apology but walked out, saying, "In the capital I heard that Xing Junya was a hero of his generation — and now you haggle over money with a petty clerk? What kind of man is that?"

sentences.zh: 」君牙慚，遽釋吏，引為上客，留月餘，以五百縑為謝。

translations.literal: Junya was ashamed, hastily released the clerk, received him as honored guest, kept him a month and more, and gave five hundred bolts of silk in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Junya was ashamed. He at once released the clerk, treated Fen as an honored guest, kept him for more than a month, and sent him off with five hundred bolts of silk in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 其屈己好士類此。

translations.literal: His humility and love of gentlemen were of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: His willingness to humble himself and his love of worthy men were like this.
